timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: Today is a big day and I feel it in my whole body.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind is running through everything that could happen.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am nervous and excited all at once.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep checking that everything is ready.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels the adrenaline of this morning.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want today to go exactly right.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me is afraid something will go wrong.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this day feels like a lot.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: There is so much energy in this moment.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let this energy settle into readiness.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I have prepared enough for this moment.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Nerves and excitement can exist together.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I do not need everything to be perfect.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can channel this energy instead of being overwhelmed by it.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can meet today one moment at a time.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Whatever happens, I can handle it.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can let myself feel ready.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can breathe through this morning.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am ready for today.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind can feel clear and present.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to meet this day well.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can enjoy this moment instead of just surviving it.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels steady and capable.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can let today unfold.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I have everything I need for this.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I am ready to step into today.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to begin.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
